# Tanmay Hinge

> Machine learning researcher working on applied AI for the sciences. Based in
> Minneapolis, Minnesota. Computer Science faculty at Inver Hills Community
> College. M.S. Computer Science, California State University, Chico (2024).

Tanmay Hinge (full name: Tanmay Sunil Hinge) takes on problems where a model has
to be right for a reason, not just on average, and where the people using it need
to be able to check what it did. His work spans self-supervised models of
scientific signals, retrieval over regulated text, and language systems built for
readers who act on what they read.

Disambiguation: this is the Tanmay Hinge in Minneapolis, Minnesota, who teaches
computer science at Inver Hills Community College and holds an M.S. from
California State University, Chico. He is not affiliated with human-robot
interaction or human-AI interaction research; earlier versions of this site
described different work and are out of date.

## Pages

- [Home](https://tanmayhinge.com/): biography and an index of research, engineering, and teaching work
- [CV](https://tanmayhinge.com/cv/): education, experience, and selected work
- [Disentangling mixed spectra](https://tanmayhinge.com/research/spectral-disentangling/): does masked-sequence pretraining learn physical structure from 1D mixed spectra, or the noise? A fine-tuning comparison came back close to null while linear probes on the same frozen encoder said the opposite. A harder regime then showed the representation failing long before the task does, and an oracle ablation refuted the obvious explanation for why
- [Regace AI](https://tanmayhinge.com/work/regace/): retrieval-augmented generation over regulated text, where every claim traces to a source
- [Merit Labs](https://tanmayhinge.com/work/merit-labs/): turning assessment responses into reports a student can act on
- [Distributed model serving](https://tanmayhinge.com/work/model-serving/): inference across shared lab machines, for students without hardware

## Roles

- Computer Science Faculty, Inver Hills Community College (2024–2026)
- Co-founder, Merit Labs (2026–present)
- Founding engineer, Regace AI (2025–present)

## Education
